<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="24" y="22" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="18" x2="330" y2="18" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="334" y1="16" x2="338" y2="16" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="342" y1="14" x2="346" y2="14" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="357" cy="16" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="353" y1="20" x2="361" y2="12" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <rect x="369" y="10" width="17" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="371" y="12" width="12" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#050505"/>
  <rect x="386" y="14" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#050505"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <polyline points="42,65 34,73 42,81" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="35" y1="73" x2="55" y2="73" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="24" y="119" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="24px" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Create new password</text>
  <text x="24" y="148" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">Choose a strong password to keep your account secure.</text>

  <!-- Form -->
  <rect x="24" y="184" width="342" height="64" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <rect x="24" y="278" width="342" height="64" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <text x="36" y="205" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">
    <tspan x="36" dy="0">New password</tspan>
    <tspan x="36" dy="26" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#050505">••••••••••••</tspan>
    <tspan x="36" dy="0" font-size="12px" fill="#ED2E7E">*</tspan>
    <tspan x="36" dy="94" font-size="12px" font-weight="600" fill="#4E4B66">Confirm new password</tspan>
    <tspan x="36" dy="26" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#050505">••••••••••••</tspan>
    <tspan x="36" dy="0" font-size="12px" fill="#ED2E7E">*</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Visibility icons -->
  <path d="M326 216 C332 207 342 207 348 216 C342 225 332 225 326 216 Z" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <path d="M326 310 C332 301 342 301 348 310 C342 319 332 319 326 310 Z" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <circle cx="337" cy="216" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="337" cy="310" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Strength and guidance -->
  <rect x="24" y="371" width="342" height="6" rx="3" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
  <rect x="24" y="371" width="228" height="6" rx="3" fill="#00BA88"/>
  <rect x="24" y="402" width="164" height="34" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
  <rect x="202" y="402" width="164" height="34" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
  <text x="24" y="393" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">
    <tspan x="24" dy="0">Password strength: </tspan><tspan font-weight="600" fill="#00BA88">Strong</tspan>
    <tspan x="24" dy="61" font-size="12px">Use 8+ characters with a number and symbol.</tspan>
    <tspan x="36" dy="22" font-size="11px">✓ 8 or more characters</tspan>
    <tspan x="214" dy="0" font-size="11px">✓ Number and symbol</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Security information -->
  <rect x="24" y="470" width="342" height="96" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <path d="M48 503 L48 494 C48 487 58 487 58 494 L58 503" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M44 503 L62 503 L62 520 L44 520 Z" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="78" y="497" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">
    <tspan x="78" dy="0">Your password is private</tspan>
    <tspan x="78" dy="23" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Keep it unique and never share it with anyone.</tspan>
    <tspan x="78" dy="20" font-size="12px" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2">Learn more</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Fixed submit action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="608" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="195" y="639" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#FFFFFF">Update password</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="770" width="390" height="74" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="770" x2="390" y2="770" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="45,801 54,793 63,801 63,812 56,812 56,805 52,805 52,812 45,812" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <line x1="136" y1="807" x2="142" y2="813" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <polygon points="204,793 213,808 195,808" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <rect x="281" y="794" width="15" height="15" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <circle cx="288.5" cy="801.5" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <text x="0" y="829" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#667080">
    <tspan x="39">Home</tspan>
    <tspan x="116">Explore</tspan>
    <tspan x="191">Saved</tspan>
    <tspan x="274">Profile</tspan>
  </text>
</svg>
